Kostecki Wins Bathurst 1000 After Rival's Error

Broc Kostecki has won the Bathurst 1000 after a critical error by rival Will Brown. Brown, who was leading the race, spun out on lap 140, allowing Kostecki to take the lead and ultimately the victory. The incident occurred at the Conrod Straight.
